culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total United States of America 1st Lien/Secured Loans | 981,617,153 | 953,252,026 | 153.57

rationale: The flagged high percent-of-net-assets value is printed in the raw schedule: table 16 row 11 reports 153.57 for the United States 1st Lien/Secured Loans subtotal. The same schedule reports total investments at 185.82% of net assets, while the balance sheet reports net assets of 620,958,706 against investments at fair value of 1,153,413,327. Percent-of-net-assets values above 100% are therefore a filing-level leverage presentation, not a pipeline data defect.
